title: Australia-Singapore Annual Leaders' Meeting 2026
summary: IntroductionThe Prime Minister and Minister for Finance of Singapore, Lawrence Wong, and the Prime Minister of Australia, the Hon Anthony Albanese MP, met for the 11th Singapore-Australia Annual Leaders’ Meeting in Canberra, on the traditional land of the Ngunnawal peoples, on 24 November 2026.In the past year, Australia and Singapore have advanced an ambitious agenda under the Comprehensive Stra…

title: Australia-Singapore Cooperation on Artificial Intelligence
summary: On the occasion of the 11th Singapore-Australia Annual Leaders’ Meeting, the Prime Ministers of Australia and Singapore underscored their shared commitment to deepen cooperation on Artificial Intelligence (AI) to further strengthen the Australia–Singapore Comprehensive Strategic Partnership 2.0.
